stem: A model of a sailing ship is built so that every length on the model is \(\frac{1}{75}\) of the corresponding length on the real ship. The model is 64 centimeters long. What is the length, in meters, of the real ship? (1 meter = 100 centimeters)
verify:
ans = Rational(64 * 75, 100)
assert ans == 48
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans
